articles.title: Zeus Wallet taken offline after cyberattack, says no customer funds at risk
articles.snippet: The self-custodial Bitcoin Lightning Network wallet disabled infrastructure after an incident and founder Evan Kaloudis said no customer funds were lost and no Lightning vulnerability was found.

articles.title: Crypto wrench attacks steal more than $30M so far in 2026: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: While only 12 of 46 documented attempts resulted in payment, data leaks and attacks on relatives are widening the physical risks facing crypto holders.

articles.title: Coldcard hackers transfer 64 BTC and 200 ETH to cryptocurrency mixers
articles.snippet: Hackers behind the Coldcard exploit transferred millions in digital assets to cryptocurrency mixers, while most stolen funds remained traceable in attacker-controlled wallets.

articles.title: Mysten Labs tech chief joins Anthropic to work on AI security
articles.snippet: Mysten Labs’ co-founder Sam Blackshear said he is joining Anthropic as AI shifts the balance between attackers and defenders.

articles.title: Crypto Wrench Attacks on Pace for Record Year as $30M Stolen in 2026: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: The blockchain analytics firm says home invasions are becoming more common, France has emerged as the leading hotspot, and some attackers are using increasingly sophisticated laundering techniques.
